title: Is Randomness Necessary for Adaptive Data Analysis?
abstract: arXiv:2607.07085v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Adaptive Data Analysis (ADA) problem formalizes the challenge of preventing false discovery and overfitting when a dataset is repeatedly reused. Formally, our input is a dataset containing $n$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{P}$ over a domain $\mathcal{X}$, and our goal is to answer a sequence of $k$ adaptively chosen statistical queries with respect to $\mathcal{P}$. The main question is how many queries we can support (i.e., how large $k$ can be), primarily as a function of the number of samples $n$. This question has been intensively studied and is relatively well-understood for randomized mechanisms: there are computationally efficient mechanisms that support $k \approx n^2$ queries, and no computationally efficient mechanism can answer $k \gg n^2$ queries. translated_title: 随机性对于自适应数据分析是必要的吗？
translated_abstract: 自适应数据分析问题形式化了当数据集被重复使用时防止虚假发现和过拟合的挑战。形式上，我们的输入是一个包含 $n$ 个来自定义域 $\mathcal{X}$ 上未知分布 $\mathcal{P}$ 的独立同分布样本的数据集，我们的目标是回答关于 $\mathcal{P}$ 的一系列 $k$ 个自适应选择的统计查询。主要问题是我们能够支持多少个查询（即 $k$ 最大可以是多少），这主要作为样本数量 $n$ 的函数。这个问题已被深入研究，并且对于随机化机制而言已相对清晰：存在计算高效的机制可以支持 $k \approx n^2$ 个查询，且没有计算高效的机制能够回答 $k \gg n^2$ 个查询。在本文中，我们解决一个根本性问题：随机性对于自适应数据分析是否必要？尽管对自适应数据分析已有十年的研究，这个问题仍然悬而未决。
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了自适应数据分析中一个根本性开放问题——随机性是否必要，即探索确定性机制能否达到与随机化机制相当的查询支持能力。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses the fundamental open question of whether randomness is necessary for adaptive data analysis, exploring whether deterministic mechanisms can match the query-support capabilities of randomized mechanisms.
